jobs.prompt: Use case: historical-scene character design. Create a NEW square head-and-shoulders portrait of LIU TANG (刘唐, 赤发鬼) from the 120-chapter Water Margin. Reference image is ONLY painterly rendering, warm parchment background, lighting and large readable bust composition. It is Ruan Xiaoqi, a DIFFERENT PERSON: DO NOT copy his lumpy face, protruding eyes, pale patchy yellow beard, hair/topknot or bare torso. Liu Tang has the novel's broad PURPLISH-DARK face (紫黑阔脸): natural deep dark-brown weathered human complexion with subdued wine/purplish undertone, broad flat strong cheeks and square jaw, heavy but natural brows, narrower deep-set dark eyes, a stout strong adult traveler with fierce direct alert expression. Human skin, not neon-purple, demon or racial caricature. The defining trait is ONE natural irregular CINNABAR RED BIRTHMARK at his anatomical RIGHT TEMPLE beside sideburn, bearing a visible small patch of short coarse BLACK-AND-YELLOWISH hairs. Three-quarter face turned slightly toward IMAGE RIGHT so the RIGHT temple is on the near/IMAGE LEFT side and fully visible. This birthmark is not an injury/tattoo/flame rune and not across the whole forehead; no second mark on left temple. Conservative design choices: short dense dark boxed beard and moustache, dark hair under a plain faded charcoal-grey knotted cloth headscarf (not officer hat), plain dull russet/earth-brown coarse short traveler coat with off-white inner collar. Exact beard, face anatomy, cloth type/color and RIGHT-side placement are game art fills, not details explicitly specified by novel. Keep headscarf pulled clear of birthmark/hairs. Massive clear distinct face, shoulders/chest framed, ENTIRE headscarf with 6% top/side margin. Same refined crisp historically inspired hand-painted realism as style reference. No red all-over head hair, glowing eyes, blood magic, vampire, ghost, divine ornaments, armor, tattoos, scars, jewelry or weapon in portrait. The nickname comes from the marked temple, not demonic powers.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this LIU TANG portrait to match the novel's 紫黑阔脸, not the tan round-eyed Ruan Xiaoqi style-reference person. Keep this exact right-temple cinnabar birthmark with black/yellowish hairs, its side/position, charcoal cloth headscarf, dark boxed beard, russet traveler clothes, parchment background, framing and painterly medium. Correct skin to a noticeably DEEP DARK BROWN human complexion with restrained plum/wine undertones in midtones and shadow; dark forehead/cheeks/neck together, still naturally readable highlights and skin texture, not tan/orange or solid pitch-black, not neon purple. Make the face wider and squarer with broad relatively FLAT cheeks and heavier square jaw, not Ruan's lumpy cheek contours. Eyes slightly smaller, narrower and DEEP-SET under the heavy brows rather than protruding round eyes; broad but natural nose bridge and blunt tip, lips fuller and firm. A distinct strong adult Chinese traveler, human and individual, not a caricature. These detailed face choices are conservative design around broad dark face from text. Keep birthmark RED against dark skin, small patch of black/ochre coarse hairs visible without turning all sideburn hair blonde. No new scar, tattoo, ornament, red all-over hair, magic or armor. Keep full headscarf inside generous blank margins and same warm parchment. The visual difference from a warm-tan bulging-eyed yellow-bearded fisherman must be clear.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make a production four-direction GAME SPRITE atlas of EXACT LIU TANG in reference portrait: deep dark-brown purplish human complexion, broad flat square face/heavy jaw, deep-set eyes, short dense dark boxed beard/moustache, dark knotted cloth headscarf and ONE cinnabar birthmark with black-and-yellowish coarse hairs at ANATOMICAL RIGHT TEMPLE only. Right-side placement is a conservative design choice. Preserve this distinct face, not a tan generic hero. Conservative ordinary traveler outfit: plain dull russet/earth-brown coarse short wrap coat to mid-thigh, off-white inner collar, charcoal cloth waist sash, loose grey trousers, grey ankle wraps and plain dark grey CLOTH SHOES with thin pale soles. No armor, rank hat, insignia, raincape, water gear, horse, tattoo or new scar. ONE practical PU DAO (朴刀), broad plain single-edged modestly curved iron blade about forearm length at end of a medium wooden handle, overall weapon around two-thirds standing body height. No thin spearpoint, huge fantasy dragon guandao, hook/trident, belt sabre or extra rod. Relaxed standing at ease, low-held pu dao, blade down-away from feet, not cutting. The RIGHT temple mark is visible on the near side in SE and NE when face side is exposed; it must NOT move to the left temple in opposite views, hide naturally on far side in SW/NW. Do not horizontally mirror the figure. Same elevated isometric orthographic camera, all four standing figures same 450px head-to-ground height; whole headcloth/feet and whole blade/butt in OWN quadrant. At least 45px clear OUTER margin and continuous empty central horizontal/vertical gutters at least 55px wide. Leave generous space, do not fill cells edge-to-edge. Refined crisp hand-painted historical strategy-game rendering, light/materials/palette as portrait. TRUE alpha transparent background, NO shadow/ground/scenery/text/checkerboard. Chapter14 clothes/headscarf and pu-dao fight; exact clothes colors, beard, shoes/shape and idle pose are conservative game art.
